# MilePost Zero: Axel - Caravan Decorator

__Name__

Axel and their companion Gyro

__Role__

Caravan Decorator

__Location:__

After being hired: From Marley’s desk, face north and follow the tunnel until you see the yellow forklift on your left. Turn west and enter the room. Axel and Gyro will spawn on the platform in the northwest corner.

__Cost__

Hire Cost (Tier 1) - 125 Supplies

Upgrade 1 (Tier 2) - 150 Supplies

Upgrade 2 (Tier 3) - 200 Supplies

__Notes__

To unlock the vendor's inventory items, plans, and next-tier level, you must go through all their dialogue options. This needs to be done before each upgrade to the next tier. If the option to upgrade doesn’t appear in Marley’s dialogue and you have enough supplies, it means you missed part of the conversation. Go back and talk to the vendor again to complete any missed dialogue, and the upgrade option should then become available.

__Snow Globe__

Yes

__Daily Quest__

No

Note: Axel's Daily Quests were cut when porting to live servers and have been removed from the game.

__Vendor__

No

__Decoration Upgrades and Costs__

Blue Ridge Theme (default)

**Tier 1**

Military Theme - 40 Supplies

**Tier 2**

Antiques Theme - 40 Supplies

**Tier 3**

Cultist Theme - 40 Supplies
